label: Tracks from pitch and offset
subgoals: Write track positions as offset plus a multiple of the pitch
Count the tracks whose position falls in the gcell range
Relate the pitch to minimum width plus spacing

label: Blockages remove tracks
subgoals: Expand the blockage by half the wire width plus the spacing
Count tracks whose centerline falls in the expanded window
Subtract the lost tracks from the gcell capacity

label: Capacity with reserved slack
subgoals: Sum usable tracks over the layers that cross the boundary
Scale each layer's tracks by one minus its adjustment and round down
